costNote: Insurance claims — $9,943M of property-casualty claims plus $77M of accident/health benefits. Catastrophe losses ran 7.1 combined-ratio points higher than last year's unusually light quarter, partly offset by more favorable reserve releases on old claims.

opex.name: Operating costs & expenses
opex.note: Running 217.6 million policies — agents, claims operations and the ALLIE AI service platform. Shown net of a $28M pension remeasurement gain.

opex.name: Amortization of policy acquisition costs
opex.note: Spreading the commissions paid to win and renew policies over their terms (DAC).

opex.name: Amortization & restructuring
opex.note: $46M of amortization on purchased intangibles plus $40M of restructuring charges.

footerNote: Insurer layout: premiums and other revenue are the top line; claims are the direct-cost block. Net income is the consolidated $2,080M; $2,050M was applicable to common shareholders after preferred dividends. Interest expense of $97M, listed by Allstate among costs and expenses, is shown below the operating line.

oneTimers.label: Tough comparison year
oneTimers.text: A year ago Allstate booked a $720M gain on selling its group health business; this year there was none, and investments swung to a $545M loss — the two explain most of the drop from $3.7B to $2.1B of net income (to common).

segments.name: Property & casualty premiums
segments.note: Auto and homeowners premiums earned — up 4.0% as policies in force grew 3.3% (auto +3.4%, homeowners +3.3%) and rate increases earned through. Recorded combined ratio 86.6.

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: Protection Plans (device and appliance coverage, growing fast internationally), dealer services, roadside and identity protection.

segments.name: Net investment income
segments.note: $1,177M of investment income (up 24%) minus $545M of net losses on investments and derivatives — the swing item in this quarter's GAAP result.

segments.name: Accident & health
segments.note: Supplemental accident and health coverage — small since the group health business was sold in 2025.

sources.label: Allstate Q3 2026 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Nov 4, 2026)

takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS of $9.76 vs GAAP $8.03 — the gap is mostly the $545M of investment/derivative losses that adjusted earnings exclude. Underwriting itself was strong: combined ratio 86.6 even with heavy catastrophes.
takeaways.title: Core underwriting is excellent

takeaways.text: Total policies in force hit 217.6 million — Property-Liability policies up 3.3%, with auto and home both gaining share on new 'Affordable, Simple and Connected' products.
takeaways.title: Growth, not just price

takeaways.text: Net income to common fell 45% to $2.05B — but the comparison is against a quarter with a $720M disposal gain and investment gains. Premiums, the controllable part, rose 4%.
takeaways.title: Headline profit down on one-offs

verdict: Excellent underwriting (86.6 combined ratio) and policy growth — GAAP profit only looks weak against last year's disposal gain.
